personal_profile.lede: I don’t set out to build products. I make works — things with a language of their own, that you remember, and come back to at different moments.

works.name: Auditorium
works.summary: An open writing platform. A room where a text is read out loud.

works.name: Arc
works.summary: A minimal messenger with a maximal spine — scalable, opinionated, quiet.

works.name: Evîn
works.summary: Offline-first, cross-platform, and named for love. It works with no signal.

works.name: WormHoleKernel
works.summary: The studio’s own engine and framework for cinematic web experiences: one frame loop under everything, built from small kits that each take on one part of the work.

disciplines.title: GAME DEVELOPMENT & ART DIRECTION
disciplines.note: Worlds made to be played and looked at: Unity and Godot in C#, Blender and Substance 3D for what is seen, shaders for how it is lit. Where the engineering is the drawing.

disciplines.title: SERVER-SIDE
disciplines.note: Go and Python where the load is. Systems that stay boring under pressure.

disciplines.title: WEB CLIENT
disciplines.note: Interfaces built like instruments: one frame loop, measured motion, nothing decorative that is not also structural.

disciplines.title: CROSS-PLATFORM
disciplines.note: One codebase, offline-first, identical on every screen it reaches.

graphics_engine.framework: Three.js (with TSL - Three Shading Language) and Custom WebGL Shaders

interactive_modes.name: singularity
interactive_modes.shader_type: Relativistic raymarching of a Schwarzschild black hole with accretion disk, photon sphere (1.5 Rs), ISCO (3.0 Rs), gravitational lensing deflection LUT (32 samples), and chromatic spectral dispersion (427nm - 677nm).

interactive_modes.name: galaxy
interactive_modes.shader_type: Multi-component spiral galaxy particle simulation featuring Nucleus, Bar, Inner/Outer Arms, Young Blue Stars, H-II Nebulae, Halo, and Interstellar Dust Reddening.

interactive_modes.name: meadow
interactive_modes.shader_type: Procedural botanical dandelion clock simulation with 168 seeds, 88 bristles per seed, and 15,161 wind-responsive fibers.

interactive_modes.name: still_life_lens
interactive_modes.shader_type: Analytical Signed Distance Field (SDF) raymarched teacup with liquid, saucer, handle, table, and dynamic day/night light casting.

frontend_stack.styling: Scoped CSS with modern CSS custom properties and mix-blend-mode for dynamic contrast
frontend_stack.typography: Self-hosted variable WOFF2 fonts (Cast Latin, Mono Latin, Sans Latin, Serif Display Latin)
frontend_stack.cursor_system: Custom reactive SVG/DOM cursor layer with state-driven ring and arm geometry responding to hovered targets (links, lens, interactive canvas)
frontend_stack.i18n_strategy: Headless dynamic sheets fetched asynchronously via /api/sheet/<locale> without full page reloads
